necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, corresponding to diagnosis codes I49.9, R42, and Z86.73. Given the concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia contributing to these symptoms, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the source of the patient's symptoms as described in the clinical indication note.
